Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.scenemanager.utils.startmenu.data

Class DisplayResource

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.scenemanager.utils.startmenu.data.DisplayResource
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class DisplayResource extends Object implements Serializable
This encapsulates the various types of resources (icons, tapps, etc.) that can be displayed to represent a menu component.
